title: MJ-12 scientists really were involved

tellings.quote: these scientists who were supposedly in the Majestic 12 group, if that was even its real name, that's all nonsense. It's just San Freriedman made the whole thing up." That's not true. They were involved.

plain: The scientists named in the Majestic 12 papers really were involved in secret UFO work in the years after 1947, says the author Whitley Strieber. Majestic 12 is a set of documents said to describe a secret group of scientists and officials who handled UFO matters. Strieber pushes back on the view that a UFO researcher named Stanton Friedman "made the whole thing up," says "That's not true. They were involved," and names the mathematician John von Neumann among them, though he does not say how he knows.
